# ghost_repository_collaborator (Resource)

Invites a user to collaborate on a repository with a role, and manages that role. Ghost sends the user an invitation, which they must accept before they get access; until then `status` is `pending`. A pending invitation is a normal end state for this resource. Invitations expire after seven days: an expired or declined invitation is removed from state, so the next apply invites the user again. Destroying the resource removes the collaborator, or withdraws the invitation if it is still pending. You must be an admin of the repository. Inviting someone who is already a collaborator adopts them and sets their role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Invite a user to the repository. The invitation stays pending until they
# accept it; destroying the resource withdraws it, or removes the
# collaborator once they have accepted.
resource "ghost_repository_collaborator" "octocat" {
  repository = ghost_repository.example.full_name
  username   = "octocat"
  role       = "write"

  # Invite them again if the repository is replaced, which drops its
  # collaborators.
  lifecycle {
    replace_triggered_by = [ghost_repository.example.repo_id]
  }
}

output "octocat_invitation" {
  value = ghost_repository_collaborator.octocat.status # "pending" or "accepted"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`. Renaming the repository updates this in place; pointing it at a different repository forces a new resource.
- `role` (String) The user's role on the repository: `read`, `triage`, `write`, `maintain` or `admin`. Changing it updates the resource in place, whether or not the invitation has been accepted.
- `username` (String) The username of the user to invite, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. It can't be the repository's owner. Changing it to another user forces a new resource; changing only its case doesn't.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When a pending invitation expires, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, seven days after `invited_at`. Null once the invitation is accepted.
- `id` (String) The repository's full name and the user's username as Ghost stores it, `owner/slug:username`.
- `invited_at` (String) When the user was invited, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Changing the role keeps it.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
- `status` (String) `pending` until the user accepts the invitation, then `accepted`. Only an accepted collaborator has access.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Collaborators, and pending invitations, are imported by the repository's
# full name and the username, "owner/slug:username".
terraform import ghost_repository_collaborator.octocat my-user/example:octocat
```
